name: dos2-gm-mcp
description: Divinity: Original Sin 2 Game Master mode: edit campaign files, drive the live game via a bridge mod
long_description: Prepare and run Game Master mode campaigns in Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition. Reads and edits campaign files through LSLib (NPC and item templates, vignettes, map stickies, journal, scene atmosphere, add-on mods) with a backup before every write, and drives the running game through a small Script Extender bridge mod (list, spawn, move, rename characters, run Lua). After installing, ask the assistant to call dos2_fetch_lslib once. Needs Windows, uv and the .NET 8 runtime.

tools.name: dos2_status
tools.description: Paths (campaigns, Divine.exe, backups), whether the game is running, and the list of GM campaigns.

tools.name: dos2_fetch_lslib
tools.description: One-time setup: downloads the official LSLib release by Norbyte (Divine.exe, MIT license) from GitHub, checks its pinned SHA-256 and unpacks it into the data folder.

tools.name: dos2_campaign
tools.description: Campaign summary: metadata and add-ons, scenes, maps with pins, vignettes, templates, sticky notes, journal.

tools.name: dos2_campaign_meta
tools.description: Changes the campaign name, description and author in meta.lsf (same as editing campaign metadata in the game).

tools.name: dos2_scene
tools.description: Scene contents from LevelCache: characters (name, root template, position, vitality, experience, alignment, encounter), encounters with their members, item count, the scene's sticky notes.

tools.name: dos2_templates
tools.description: Campaign templates from Eggs.lsf: kind = "npc", "item", or empty for all.

tools.name: dos2_template
tools.description: A full template: base stats, GM edits, abilities, talents, skills, skill bar, items.

tools.name: dos2_find_templates
tools.description: Searches templates in all campaigns (or in one) by a substring of the name, StatName, root template, skills and items.

tools.name: dos2_vignettes
tools.description: The campaign's vignettes in full: title, text, question, answers, image.

tools.name: dos2_notes
tools.description: GM sticky notes: on an Overview map (kind=map) and in scenes, bound to an object (kind=scene).

tools.name: dos2_raw
tools.description: A campaign file as LSX text, for exploring the formats.

tools.name: dos2_put_npc_template
tools.description: Creates or changes an NPC template (the GM's saved templates in the "Creatures and Items" panel).

tools.name: dos2_put_item_template
tools.description: Creates or replaces an item template (the GM's saved item templates in the "Creatures and Items" panel).

tools.name: dos2_put_journal
tools.description: Writes the whole GM journal (the previous one goes to a backup).

tools.name: dos2_scene_settings
tools.description: Changes a scene in GMScenes.lsf: name, folder, atmosphere (a GUID from ATM_*), ambient sound (Soundvol_*) and music (GM_*).

tools.name: dos2_delete_template
tools.description: Deletes an NPC or item template by name.

tools.name: dos2_put_vignette
tools.description: Creates or replaces a vignette.

tools.name: dos2_delete_vignette
tools.description: Deletes a vignette by UUID or title.

tools.name: dos2_put_note
tools.description: Creates or changes a GM sticky note (players do not see it).

tools.name: dos2_delete_note
tools.description: Deletes a sticky note by UUID or title.

tools.name: dos2_backup
tools.description: Full copy of the campaign folder into the backups.

tools.name: dos2_backups
tools.description: The campaign's backups, newest first: what was saved and which files the operation created.

tools.name: dos2_restore
tools.description: Restores the files from a backup and deletes the files that operation created.

tools.name: dos2_live_status
tools.description: Live layer readiness: whether the game is running, Script Extender is installed, the bridge is built, which campaigns it is attached to, and whether its heartbeat is coming in (the bridge writes it...

tools.name: dos2_bridge_install
tools.description: Builds the bridge mod into Mods\DOS2GMBridge_….pak and, if campaign is given, attaches it to the campaign as an add-on (meta.lsf → Dependencies, with a backup).

tools.name: dos2_mod_install
tools.description: Builds a mod from the source folder (it contains Mods/<mod folder>/meta.lsx) into Mods\<mod folder>.pak and, if campaign is given, attaches it to the campaign as an add-on.

tools.name: dos2_addon
tools.description: Attaches a ready-made third-party mod from a .pak file to the campaign (attach=False detaches it).

tools.name: dos2_bridge_detach
tools.description: Detaches the bridge mod from the campaign (meta.lsf → Dependencies, with a backup).

tools.name: dos2_live_characters
tools.description: Characters on the loaded level: GUID, name, root template, stats, level, vitality, alignment, position.

tools.name: dos2_live_spawn
tools.description: Spawns a character on the loaded level.

tools.name: dos2_live_move
tools.description: Moves a character (name or GUID) to the point x, y, z, or next to the character near with offset dx, dz.

tools.name: dos2_live_set
tools.description: Changes a placed character: name above the head, level (up only), alignment ("Evil NPC" etc.).

tools.name: dos2_live_stage
tools.description: Takes a character off stage (on=false) or brings it back (on=true).

tools.name: dos2_live_lua
tools.description: Runs Lua on the game server (Script Extender, in the bridge mod's context) and returns the value of return.
